Kai (Luminity): Hey team — heads up: we're doing a high-stakes APAC pilot/demo tomorrow 09:00 JST. Need a short-lived allowlist + temporary QPS bump for 2-4 hours. Procurement wants positive perf to finalize renewal.
Alyssa (CS): Thanks Kai — can you paste source IPs and SNI/domain you’ll use? Also rough peak QPS and how long you expect the window to run?
Kai (Luminity): IPs below and SNI. Peak ~2.5k QPS for ~4h, with a short peak burst. This demo is with three enterprise buyers, so it’s critical.
Kai (Luminity): ```
203.0.113.45
203.0.113.46
2001:db8::45
SNI: api.luminity-demo.com
```
Omar (NetOps): Got it. Need CIDR notation or /32 entries, and confirmation you control that domain cert CN. Which APAC region do you want routed to (sg / ap-northeast1 / tokyo)?
Kai (Luminity): Singapore (ap-southeast-1) is ideal. Cert CN = api.luminity-demo.com. We can provide cert fingerprint if needed.
Priya (SRE): We can carve a canary route into the sg pool and apply a temporary policy. Proposed settings: 2400 steady QPS, 5k max burst, auto-revoke after 48 hours. Add a soft-fail fallback to 600 QPS if latency/regressions detected.
Alyssa (CS): I’d prefer auto-revoke at 48h (we’ll review for extension). Kai — this is the event that influences renewal, so we’ll document the SLA expectations post-demo.
Omar (NetOps): I will create an infra ticket and push the allowlist once approved. Using these values — please confirm this JSON payload before I apply it: 
```
allowlist:["203.0.113.45/32","203.0.113.46/32","2001:db8::45/128"],
region: "ap-southeast-1",
steady_qps: 2400,
burst_qps: 5000,
revoke_after_hours: 48,
sni: "api.luminity-demo.com"
```
Priya (SRE): Also adding a health trigger: if 95th percentile latency > 1.2s for 5m or error rate > 3% for 3m, automatically drop to 600 QPS and page SRE. That gives CS time to mitigate rather than full outage.
infra-bot: INF-5843 created by Omar (NetOps). Approvers: @Priya (SRE) @Alyssa (CS). ETA: ~90 minutes to schedule and push config.
Alyssa (CS): Perfect — Kai, Omar will DM you once INF-5843 is live and send a short smoke checklist. Please run a smoke test at 08:50 JST to verify routing and TLS. :thumbsup:
Kai (Luminity): Thanks team — confirming the JSON payload and schedule. I’ll run the smoke test and share results. Really appreciate the quick turn on this — will let procurement know the plan. :pray:
